adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(...) } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, so the caught `err` is not logged/propagated and the mutation still returns success (`return { message: "Guests added" }`). This can mislead users (UI success toast) and reduces observability/debuggability, but it doesn’t break the core functionality of adding guests since the DB update and calendar attendee update occur before the email try/catch.
